review_decisions.hypothesis: Historical metrics and CSV arithmetic reproduce unchanged.
review_decisions.negative_controls: All36 rows, extras, original FPS representation and empty exports.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Unchanged source/profile reproduce actual neural observations and all semantic endpoints.
review_decisions.negative_controls: All17268 frames,447 contacts/strokes,39 interval/end-reason triples and CSV bytes.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: One device/configuration repeat does not establish universal determinism.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Top-k evidence isolates background effects with exact rolling-output parity.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Fixed-startup,zero concat inputs, real floor/static/high-flight and identical chunks/weights/resize.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Fewer accepted points are not localization accuracy; zero concat is not a trained background-free model.

review_decisions.hypothesis: A single competing point can block a real upper-flight bracket.
review_decisions.negative_controls: GT7 early-preparation regression and GT15 improvement retained separately.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: GT7 becomes81frames early; aggregateF1 conceals regression.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Qualification before loss restricts association to mature events.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Original35 matched endpoints retained; no idle starts, contact or coordinate edits; unavailablefuture/cuts/floor controls.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Early legitimate candidates can still be lost; onset semantics unresolved.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Observed-bracket image curve recovers high flight without inventing points.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Every leave-one-out apex, same gap/speed/context bounds; GT1/26 maturity controls.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Pixel-space fit is not3D/calibrated covariance; no incremental benefit after mask fix.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Explicit slope sensitivity and absolute gain remove near-zero ratio amplification.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Zero-incoming weak serves, jitter/apex/stop, scene/interpolation and all36 rows.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: GT27 newly missed; old trial changes rallyprovider relative later trials so not a clean maskfactorial.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Player continuity exposes histogram-missed same-camera edits.
review_decisions.negative_controls: 1246 source pairs and fullGT27 fast-action controls; no chosen threshold.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: No independent edit/occlusion labels; cut detection is separate from annotation onset.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Floor-derived finite mask incorrectly rejects source-visible image-top flight.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Same checkpoint/background/resize/60frame chunks, floor/horizontal invalidgeometry and neighboringcourt controls.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Image columns do not prove3D ownership; component copied reference events are not predictions.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Mask admission and qualified singleton association address distinct losses.
review_decisions.negative_controls: All36 rows; all35 common v1 rows; curve-on bytes/metrics identical.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Cached cadence cannot establish fresh fullpipeline accuracy.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Upstream fixes survive actual cadence feedback and complete export.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Both historical references, all36 rows/all extras, own neural/backend/model/resource evidence.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Perfect developmentF1 does not validate contact/terminal evidence, fine boundaries or generalization.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Own-cache trace explains actual decisions with exact interval and contact parity.
review_decisions.negative_controls: 288 cache hashes,457 contact/stroke timestamps,36 reason-bearing endpoints and CSV bytes.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Replay is not additional neural inference.

review_decisions.hypothesis: GT27 recovery critically depends on suspect contact12766.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Remove only selected12766 after unchanged NMS; all17268steps/all35otherrows/allremaining contact components exact.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Manual targeted intervention is never an inference fix. Fresh-own result independently verifies hybrid finding.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Restored raw motion might make reliable contact scoring sufficient without T-switch artifacts.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Same newmask owncache, tracklet flags, explicit sensitivity and all36 rows.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: GT27 fragments/end12744, oneFP,endMAE16.667 despite154estimatedcontacts; lower count not contactaccuracy.

review_decisions.hypothesis: One compact static competing cluster might explain the T interruption.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Existing cell-scale radius, matureevent, no inputmutation, floor-stop/fresh-launch/cut/slowflight controls.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Zero alternatives across916frames; centroid outliers violate compactness. No radius widening/outlier deletion/continuity adoption.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Separate rawmodel absence from mask/view/geometry rejection for every delayed start.
review_decisions.negative_controls: 1197+1779 literal paired outputs maxdifference0, owncache/provider/source hashes and original pixels.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: 5081 diagnostic frames/all36 onsetwindows; early strong responses in closeups are not observable sporting onsets.

review_decisions.hypothesis: Header, executor identity, recorded resets and cache/trace binding are software defects.
review_decisions.negative_controls: Empty/nonempty bytes, eight historical ablation outputs, 12red/14green packaging controls, full77benchmark tests.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: No score gain attributed to tools; frozen baseline retains explicitly labelled legacy package compatibility.

review_decisions.hypothesis: All historical evidence and measurements remain intact.
review_decisions.negative_controls: 2174 checks,1766 files,86 oldsource blobs,28 historical metric objects; oldinventory fields/status history exact.
review_decisions.risks_and_limits: Ignored artifacts are locally retained, not embedded as Git media/cache data.

H01.conclusion: Qualified singleton association recovers the later GT23 split while retaining GT22 as a separate interval.
H01.limitation: Both same-camera edits remain unflagged; the annotated GT23 onset precedes the visible edit and its convention is unknown.
H01.next_action: Review independent same-camera cuts and fast-play/occlusion controls before adopting a foreground continuity detector.

H02.conclusion: New upper-flight admission restores source-visible re-entry. The conditional GT27 end improves from 12748 to 12954.
H02.limitation: The T attractor and stationary-end proposal persist. Recovery still uses suspect legacy contact 12766; interval accuracy does not validate this contact or landing.
H02.next_action: Completed suppression and reliable-contact controls prove the dependency. Test richer association with reviewed floor/landing and close-rally controls; the fixed-radius cluster counterfactual failed and must not be widened to fit this case.

H03.conclusion: Identical-context fresh inference exposes 16 strong GT31 peaks rejected by the old mask; admission restores ordinary top-exit continuity without curve support.
H03.limitation: Frames 14651–14682 remain subthreshold/physically unverified. The pickup close-up cannot justify backdating the start into unobservable footage.
H03.next_action: Review launch/contact onset semantics and the remaining visibility gap independently; retain missing observations rather than inventing coordinates.

H04.conclusion: GT4/22 early starts remain unchanged by the selected mask/association changes. GT22 contact context crosses an unflagged 10603→10604 edit.
H04.limitation: GT4's earlier high-flight/feed sequence has ambiguous sporting onset; detecting the GT22 edit alone does not prove its first weak contact will disappear.
H04.next_action: Obtain reviewed onset/contact/cut labels, then test independent provisional-start validation while retaining GT2/19/20.

H05.conclusion: All 36 rows have source-bound first-provider/processed/motion/contact/start/cancellation/end records; upstream admission rescues several cancelled early events.
H05.limitation: Late starts persist through weak motion, view exclusion, ambiguous preparation and cancellations. First provider output is not a verified sporting onset.
H05.next_action: Review remaining large delays by causal group, using current-frame pose/racket acquisition only where it can distinguish competing explanations.

H06.conclusion: End errors are evaluated independently; the major GT27 truncation improves and every remaining end proposal stays traceable.
H06.limitation: Neither static coordinates nor slow players establish landing. GT10/16 and other residual end errors remain; physical terminal labels are absent.
H06.next_action: Review terminal contact/landing/disappearance separately and test reversible terminal validation without increasing merge gaps.

H07.conclusion: Full metrics retain start/end MAE, RMSE, median, bias, P90, max and all requested tolerances with both denominators.
H07.limitation: High detection recall does not establish frame-level boundaries; multi-second onset outliers and early GT4/22 remain.
H07.next_action: Resolve annotation conventions and evaluate starts and ends independently on reviewed unseen matches.

H08.conclusion: Codec 18 diagnostics retain ranked components, raw/masked peaks, selection/rejection reasons, entropy, model votes and background digest with exact frame/provider identity.
H08.limitation: Top-k connected components above a diagnostic floor are not every local peak or a calibrated posterior. Unrecorded historical heatmaps remain unavailable.
H08.next_action: Use bounded evidence for association experiments; extend the versioned schema only when a concrete missing field is required.

H09.conclusion: Three background arms hold checkpoints/resize/masks/chunks fixed; rolling reproduces all 1811 observations/supports exactly. Fixed-startup removes 24/24 T outputs but does not recover the true track.
H09.limitation: Zero concat input is not a separately trained background-free model. Resize-only and broader background generalization remain unmeasured.
H09.next_action: Evaluate context/association first; use controlled interpolation/background ablations with independently reviewed localization controls.

H10.conclusion: The optional reliable-motion provider removes unstable relative gain, exposes slope sensitivity and passes weak-launch/zero-incoming controls.
H10.limitation: Its old-perception semantic trial newly misses GT27. The selected candidate retains legacy scoring, and suspect 12766 still has saturated ratio cues.
H10.next_action: Both completed controls confirm the coupling. Validate static-to-track association and reviewed contact precision/recall before replacing the provider; the new-mask reliable trial also fragments GT27.

H11.conclusion: Fresh/carried boxes, actual pose stride, keypoint availability and racket evidence are visible in the new bounded replay.
H11.limitation: No event-triggered pose/racket policy was accepted, and sparse evidence has no independently measured contact-error attribution.
H11.next_action: Test current-frame event-triggered acquisition on reviewed uncertain contacts with compute-cost and frontier controls.

H12.conclusion: Player diagnostics expose raw-query counters/top-k boxes, rejection/ROI reasons, carried state and tracker admission/capacity without changing decisions.
H12.limitation: Historical rejected boxes cannot be recreated from caches, and no reviewed detection/association/identity labels were added.
H12.next_action: Review ROI, carried detections and identity episodes on independent singles/four-player sequences before changing admission or association.

H13.conclusion: Invalid/offscreen geometry and adjacent columns retain regression controls; floor and player admission rules remain unchanged.
H13.limitation: Full-height court columns are an image prior, not 3D airborne ownership, line-call or landing accuracy.
H13.next_action: Review projected court geometry and airborne multi-court overlap on authorized independent footage.

H14.conclusion: Actual runtime records preserve unavailable OSNet/ReID degradation and unknown named identity; no embeddings or names were fabricated.
H14.limitation: Tracking episodes, people, teams and scoring slots remain distinct. ReID accuracy and its boundary effect remain unknown.
H14.next_action: Only a separate authorized weight/license/hash/runtime/identity-labelled experiment can justify enabling ReID.

H15.conclusion: Telemetry labels raw model support, heuristic fusion and fit sensitivity explicitly. Actual runtime providers/dtypes/fallbacks/model hashes are retained.
H15.limitation: No score calibration was fitted. ORT provider registration alone does not establish every operator's GPU placement or precision.
H15.next_action: Calibrate only against independent labels; use provider profiling if node-level execution attribution is required.
